<description>
This PR is part of integrating silent payments into Bitcoin Core. Status and tracking for the project is managed in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/28536

Prerequisite PRs:
- [ ] https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35301
- [ ] https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35302

This PR:
- Adds a Silent Payments descriptor implemenation
- Adds a `SilentPaymentsDescriptorScriptPubKeyMan` Impl that is a subclass of `DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan`
- Implements Silent Payments scanning for the wallet
- Updates sending logic to use `silent-payments` destination for change when sending to `silent-payments` destination
- Adds unit and functional tests for silent payments-related functionality

**Follow-ups**
- Silent Payments Label functionality is incomplete in this PR and will be added as a follow-up PR.
</description>

<previous_assessment>
- open concerns: Blocked upstream by libsecp256k1 issue #1799 to standardize and release BIP 352 primitives.
- open concerns: Fast rescans are disabled for silent payment wallets because block filter indexes cannot predetermine one-time scriptPubKeys.
- open concerns: Functional test suggestions regarding descriptor checksum helpers and cleanups need addressing.
- resolved concerns: Simplified key handling by separating the scan private key out of the standard signing provider flow.
- resolved concerns: Handled fallback change output logic when creating transactions from silent-payment-only wallets.
- resolved concerns: Restricted sp() descriptors to single path and added GUI dropdown support for receiving.
- Sjors tested wallet creation and rescanning across multiple revisions and provided GUI and descriptor integration suggestions.
- josibake provided detailed architectural feedback on key derivation, provider interfaces, and descriptor structures.
- rkrux contributed test review comments.
</previous_assessment>

<new_statements>
[2026-09-18] rc:4050728072 inline on src/wallet/wallet.cpp by bitsagarob (edited 2026-09-18):
`spent_coins` is built here but not passed to `SyncTransaction`, and `IsMine` gates silent payment scanning on `!spent_coins.empty()`, so block-connected transactions are never scanned. The mempool and rescan call sites both pass it. The functional tests always relay through the scanning node's own mempool, so they don't catch it.

Effect: a payment arriving only in a block isn't detected (`-blocksonly`, or the node offline while it was mined), and the balance stays 0 across restarts until a manual `rescanblockchain`.

Looks like a rebase casualty rather than deferred work: the older branches pass it here. Adding `, spent_coins` fixes it, and receiving, sending and wallet_basic still pass.
</new_statements>
